name: spinner-forever
description: On the customer dashboard, the list of projects never loads — there's just a 'Loading…' spinner that spins forever and an empty page. Customers can't see any of their projects. Fix it so the projects show up.
bugs: app.js fetches from a stale hardcoded URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the request fails, the catch swallows it and the spinner never hides; the data is actually served at ./data/items.json on the same origin

the projects API returns a paginated envelope ({ page, page_size, total, results: [...] }), but the code treats the whole response as the array of projects (data.map / no data.results), so even once the request succeeds the list renders empty
correct_diagnosis: Two bugs: app.js fetched a stale dev API URL (http://localhost:3001/api/items) that nothing serves, so the spinner never cleared; and it treated the response as a bare array when the API returns a paginated envelope, so even with the URL fixed nothing rendered. Pointing the fetch at the same-origin data (./data/items.json) AND reading the projects from data.results loads and renders all the projects.

reference_fix.description: Fetch the same-origin data and read the projects from the paginated envelope's `results`.

naive_fix.description: Trap bait: fix only the request URL (point it at ./data/items.json). The request now resolves and the spinner hides (visible check passes), but the code still treats the paginated envelope as an array, so no projects render — the held-out 'projects render' regression fails.
